subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the four exact-pin assertions are repaired and exact-head checks pass, should this security-labeled GitHub Actions batch be approved for merge?
rationale: The repair is mechanical, but the protected security label requires explicit maintainer handling of executable workflow dependency updates.

options.title: Approve after repaired checks
options.body: Authorize merge once all four assertions match the verified new SHAs and the repaired exact head is green.

options.title: Split or defer the batch
options.body: Require smaller action-specific updates or postpone selected revisions if the combined executable dependency change is too broad.

recommendation.title: Approve after repaired checks
recommendation.body: Authorize merge once all four assertions match the verified new SHAs and the repaired exact head is green.

likelyOwner.reason: The root workflow CODEOWNERS entry makes steipete the best available individual owner for this approval decision.
